checks.name: Level-one rapidfire remains a single-target shot
Level-three rapidfire retains full direct damage and adds 45% nearby splash
Secondary rapidfire splash is applied once without recursive shots
Frost levels one and two retain slow without area freeze
Frost level two still targets one enemy
Level-three frost freezes and slows a small group without touching distant enemies
Boss control resistance still shortens tower freezes
Several max-tier frost towers cannot refresh an enemy's shared freeze lock
The target can be frozen again after its three-second control window
A reused enemy cannot inherit a previous spawn's immunity
Level-three Blast retains full area damage and gains stronger shatter
A group shatter consumes only the direct frost mark and never chains itself
Max-tier barracks strengthen their three soldiers and field a distinct champion
The champion's first two strikes remain normal attacks
Every third champion strike cleaves nearby foes at 60% without hitting distant foes
Max-tier sanctuary applies 38% vulnerability for three seconds
Max-tier sanctuary heals living troops by 22 per second
Max-tier sanctuary emits extra runes and jade light columns
Elite guards have distinct, reusable equipment without creating repeated copies
A champion's final killing strike ends combat without a post-victory cleave
